Terms & Conditions
Draft dated 31 October 2026 | THE PRODUCERS

1. Provider and scope
DAYDEV CO., LTD. (the Company) provides THE PRODUCERS for entertainment. In-game money, income, rankings and transactions are fictional and have no cash redemption value unless expressly agreed otherwise. These terms do not waive mandatory consumer or statutory rights.

2. Play and accounts
Offline play does not require an account. Online features require authentication data and an internet connection. Protect your credentials and do not use another person's account without permission. Minors must obtain permission from their legal representative where required by law. Guest accounts are online accounts, not offline play.

3. Music and storage
The game stores music, covers and references such as song IDs, filenames, paths and URLs to locate, play, download and associate works with saves or accounts. When signed in and cloud storage is configured, actual audio and cover files may upload automatically after production; storage is not limited to file paths. Keep backups of important works. Signing out or uninstalling does not request deletion of cloud data.

4. Rights in works
Storage alone does not transfer ownership of a player's work to the Company. You permit only the copying, storage, format conversion and delivery needed for the services you use, not sale of your work or advertising use. Existing rights in game components, software, sounds and third-party media remain with their owners. Exporting a song does not guarantee exclusive rights, copyright protection or commercial rights in third-party elements or AI outputs.

5. Appropriate use
Do not infringe others' rights, send malware, disrupt services or access data without authority. Avoid personal or sensitive information in studio names, song titles or content sent online. Publishing a ranking makes the studio name and scores visible to users with access to rankings.

6. External services and availability
Online features may depend on Google/Firebase, Cloudinary and, when enabled, Hugging Face. Services can change or become unavailable. We do not guarantee permanent file retention or uninterrupted operation and will provide appropriate notice of material changes. This does not exclude liabilities that cannot lawfully be excluded.

7. Restrictions and changes
The Company may restrict misuse proportionately and provide reasons and a way to challenge the decision where practicable. Material changes to these terms will be notified with appropriate advance notice. Fresh consent will be requested where legally required. Accepting these terms is not blanket permission to process data for any purpose.

8. Law and contact
Thai law applies subject to mandatory protections applicable to players. You may contact the Company or bring a complaint or claim to the competent authority or court.

privacy_body:
Privacy Policy
Draft dated 31 October 2026 | THE PRODUCERS

1. Controller and purpose limitation
DAYDEV CO., LTD. controls personal data for its services. We use data only as needed to operate gameplay, reference storage locations and retrieve music, authenticate accounts and provide related online features. We do not sell or rent personal data, use it for targeted advertising or build marketing profiles. The Company does not use personal data or player works to train AI models. External providers' processing must also be assessed under their service terms.

2. Data and sources
Local gameplay supplies saves, progress, Producer/Studio names, settings, music/MIDI, covers, song IDs, filenames, paths and URLs for saving and retrieving works. Paths and filenames may themselves identify people.
Firebase/Google supplies account email, identifiers, Guest status and session tokens for authentication. The game keeps a local session for subsequent sign-ins; it does not put passwords in saves. Google sign-in requests openid/email, not contacts or Drive files.
The game records document version, time and a hash of the account identifier locally. A hash may still be linkable to a person. Online providers may receive IP addresses and request logs according to their configuration and policies.

3. Purposes and legal bases
Saving gameplay, locating files, authentication and requested features use data necessary to perform the service contract. Necessary security and abuse prevention may rely on legitimate interests, taking players' rights into account. Legally required retention or disclosures rely on legal obligations. Where an activity requires consent, we will request it separately for that purpose and allow withdrawal. Acknowledging this policy is not blanket consent.

4. Data leaving your device
Firebase/Google authenticates and operates accounts.
Cloudinary receives actual audio and cover files, song identifiers and an account identifier for storage and retrieval when signed in and cloud storage is configured. Upload may occur automatically after production, including for Guest accounts. Media links may be accessible to anyone holding the link; do not treat this as confidential-document storage.
When you publish rankings, Firestore receives studio name, fame and reputation linked to your account identifier. Emails, tokens and full saves are not displayed in rankings.
If the Hugging Face music provider is configured, song titles and genre descriptions are sent to generate audio.
The Company discloses only necessary data to relevant service providers, authorized support personnel or legally competent authorities, not to sell personal data or works.

5. Choices
Offline play does not require email but still saves local data and files. Account, cloud and ranking features need their relevant data. Guest mode is still online. AI provider configuration is not proof of the player's consent to every processing activity. Avoid sensitive information in names or submitted content.

6. Retention and deletion
Local data remains until deleted or overwritten, and uninstalling may leave the data folder. This version has no automatic cloud deletion or complete in-game account deletion button. Signing out clears the local session, not the account, ranking or uploaded media.
The Company will retain service data only as needed for active accounts and files, and delete or anonymize it when no longer needed or when an applicable deletion request takes effect, except for legal obligations or necessary legal claims. Provider backups and logs may have different deletion cycles; relevant periods must be explained when handling a request.

7. Security and international transfers
The Company must implement appropriate security and limit access to what is necessary. No system guarantees absolute security. Providers may process data outside Thailand. Before enabling services, the Company must verify storage locations, processor agreements and a lawful transfer mechanism. Acknowledging this policy is not a waiver of rights or consent to all countries. Breaches will be assessed and notified to the appropriate parties when and within the periods required by law.

8. Your rights and contact
Subject to legal conditions, you may request access or copies, correction, deletion, restriction, objection, portability and withdrawal of consent for consent-based activities. Withdrawal does not affect earlier lawful processing and may prevent dependent features from functioning. We may request only necessary identity verification and explain any refusal. You may complain to Thailand's Office of the Personal Data Protection Committee.
